item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00147","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C25","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s resignation-acceptance letter. Both begin with unusually personal reluctance and reference circumstances known in advance, formally accept the resignation with an effective date, then develop an extended appraisal of the official’s talents and prior national service before emphasizing how much the departing official will be missed. The child adapts that sequence to Hobby’s wartime leadership and organization of a new department. C25 has a similarly detailed war-service-to-Cabinet retrospective and reluctant acceptance, while C20 shares Eisenhower’s language of reluctant acceptance, invaluable service, counsel, and personal loss, but neither matches the child’s complete rhetorical progression as closely as C04.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"This is one of the hardest letters I have ever had to write. For months, since you first discussed them with me, I have recognized that personal obligations and responsibilities might make your resignation as Secretary an inescapable decision.","parent_excerpt":"I have now to take a step which from the bottom of my heart I wish could be indefinitely deferred. In acquiescing in your wishes I am moved by circumstances with which I have long been familiar.","explanation":"Both open with highly personal reluctance and stress that the circumstances compelling resignation had been known and discussed beforehand."},{"child_excerpt":"I now have no alternative than to accept it, effective August first.","parent_excerpt":"Reluctantly, therefore, and with deep regret I accept, effective at the close of business on next Tuesday, January thirty-first, the resignation","explanation":"The formal acceptance with an explicit effective date follows the same placement and construction."},{"child_excerpt":"Twice, in little more than a decade, you have earned the thanks and respect of your fellow-citizens.","parent_excerpt":"You have also earned the thanks of the Nation which you have served so selflessly.","explanation":"Both frame the departing official’s service as having earned national gratitude."},{"child_excerpt":"In official Washington, many thousands as well as I will miss you.","parent_excerpt":"I shall miss you--we shall all miss you.","explanation":"The closing movement expands the President’s personal sense of loss into the loss felt by the wider government community."}]}
